hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -f "$R/graphify-out/graph.json" ]; then echo "graphify: graph.json 없음 — 생성한다 (AST-only, 무료)"; graphify update "$R" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; echo "graphify 정책: 큰 산출물(graph.json / cache/ast / 날짜 스냅샷)은 ignore 대상 — 커밋 금지." " 규칙 전문 AGENTS.md '## graphify'. 세션 종료 시 Stop 훅이 update+prune 을 자동 실행한다."

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; graphify update "$R" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; bash "$R/tool/graphify_prune.sh" --apply 2>&1 | tail -2 || true
